nodes.label: Base Estratégica Corporativa
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: Corporate strategy document (2025) defining the venture, vision, mission, values and SMART objectives for AMOTIF as a collaborative music platform.

nodes.label: Git for Musicians Analogy
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: AMOTIF positions itself as a versioning system for audio projects — analogous to Git in software — filling the gap between local DAWs and generic file-sharing platforms by offering native tracking of versions, stems and millisecond-level layer offsets.

nodes.label: AMOTIF Vision
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: Become the global infrastructure for music collaboration, making artist collaboration as natural and traceable as open-source software development.

nodes.label: AMOTIF Mission
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: Give musicians, producers and composers an intuitive yet technical platform to create, version and synchronize projects as a team, removing distance, format and tooling barriers.

nodes.label: Corporate Values
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: Six values: radical collaboration, openness and transparency, technical precision with artistic sensitivity, accessibility without borders, continuous iteration (versions and drafts as first-class citizens), and responsibility toward creators' rights and credits.

nodes.label: Technical Precision with Artistic Sensitivity
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: Milliseconds matter as much as melodies — technology in service of art without giving up rigor.

nodes.label: SMART Objectives
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: Four SMART goals: MVP beta launch by Dec 2025 with 500 signups in 30 days; 10,000 MAU by Dec 2026; R$ 50,000 MRR by Jun 2027 with 5% free-to-paid conversion; internationalization in English/Spanish across 3 LATAM and 2 European countries by Dec 2027.
